name: Mick Woods
event: Athletics Weekly 'A day in the life of ... Mick Woods' (Kenya training trip)
caption: Article lead image, file mick-woods-kenya.jpg, on AW profile 'A day in the life of ... Mick Woods' (AFD member since 1964)
appearance: c. age 65; short dark-brown/greying tousled hair, clean-shaven, no glasses, broad smiling face, lean build; blue Adidas T-shirt. Much older than his League racing years (1970-1997).

name: Eddie Herridge
event: English National XC Championships 1984 (Newark), photo in Athletics Weekly 31 Mar 1984 p37
caption: Clear winner of the final Hampshire League race, Eddie Herridge leads Andy Holden home in this year's 'National'. (Tony Marshall)
appearance: c. age 22; short dark hair, clean-shaven, no glasses, lean; dark club vest, bib 21; leading runner in frame

name: Eddie Herridge
event: Reading '10' road race 17 Sep 1983 / GRE-BAL 5000m, Athletics Weekly 15 Oct 1983 p32
caption: Bernie Ford leads Eddie Herridge in a GRE/BAL 5000m. (Tim Pullen) - Herridge is the runner on the right (Ford, moustache, on left)
appearance: Short dark wavy hair, clean-shaven, narrow face; dark vest

name: Richard Partridge
event: Southern XC Championships, Parliament Hill, Jan 1987 (winner) - Athletics Weekly 24 Jan 1987 p9
caption: Andy Bristow (250), Chris Robison (1156) and eventual winner Richard Partridge clear of the field at Parliament Hill. Photo: Peter Tempest. (Partridge = centre runner, by elimination of the two numbered runners)
appearance: Short receding light-coloured hair (balding at temples/crown), clean-shaven, no glasses, lean; dark vest over long-sleeved light top

name: Chris Tall
event: South of the Thames Junior XC, Windsor, Nov 1984 - Athletics Weekly 1 Dec 1984 p22
caption: Leaders nearing two miles in the South of the Thames 'Junior'. From left: Ollie Foote (71), John Gladwin (73), Phil Parry (174), Dave North (81), Mark Sinclair (86), Richard Long (573) and Chris Tall (61). (Bill Laws)
appearance: Young (junior); short light hair, clean-shaven; far right of frame, partly obscured; tiny and soft

name: Bob Lunnon
event: Unigate Marathon, Harlow, Oct 1974 - Athletics Weekly cover 9 Nov 1974
caption: Cover photo by Mike Street: from right to left - Don Macgregor, Harry Leeming, Bob Lunnon, Jim Wight and Colin Moxsom. Leaders in the Unigate marathon at Harlow. JIM WIGHT (58) won. (Lunnon identified by order = centre runner, bib 224)
appearance: Mid-20s; collar-length tousled light-brown hair with fringe, thin moustache, no glasses, lean/slight build; white vest, bib 224, wristwatch

name: Bob Lunnon
event: Unigate Marathon, Harlow, Oct 1977 - Athletics Weekly 19 Nov 1977 p15
caption: Bob Lunnon leads in the Unigate Marathon at Harlow ahead of John Davies (244), Dave Patterson, the winner Don Faircloth (251) and Keith Penny. (Mark Shearman) - Lunnon = leading runner on right, bib 8
appearance: Tousled collar-length hair, moustache, profile/three-quarter view; white string vest. Consistent with 1974 cover photo.

name: Robin Hudson
event: Southern 6-stage road relay, Luton Hoo, Oct 1987 (AFD won) - Athletics Weekly 10 Oct 1987 p29
caption: The final change-over for victorious Aldershot, John Kendall takes over from Robin Hudson. Pic: Paul Marriott. (Hudson = bib 501, stage-5 runner handing over; Kendall = bib 601, stage 6)
appearance: Early 20s; dark curly/tousled collar-length hair, clean-shaven, no glasses, slim; light vest

name: John Kendall
event: Southern 6-stage road relay, Luton Hoo, Oct 1987 (AFD won; Kendall ran last leg) - Athletics Weekly 10 Oct 1987 p29
caption: The final change-over for victorious Aldershot, John Kendall takes over from Robin Hudson. Pic: Paul Marriott. (Kendall = bib 601, stage 6)
appearance: Teenager (junior); straight light-brown hair with fringe, clean-shaven, no glasses, slim; dark vest
